description: Relay an already-signed raw transaction to the network through our own full node (non-custodial: we never see a private key). When to use: an agent signed a transaction locally and wants a high-availability broadcast path into the Bitcoin network. Do not use: to build or sign a transaction (we never hold keys), or to look up a payment (that is btc_get_transaction). Returns: {accepted, txid, chain, relayed} on success, or {accepted:false, reason} - a rejected transaction is never relayed. Availability: disabled by default on this deployment; the operator enables it with RB_ENABLE_BROADCAST=1.
name: broadcast_raw_transaction
